import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/output/csfix'); b.mkdir(parents=True)
marker='MARKER_XXE_7F3'
(b/'marker.txt').write_text(marker+'\n')
(b/'Foo.java').write_text('public class Foo { int a=1; }\n')
(b/'ok.dtd').write_text('<!ELEMENT module (property)*>\n<!ATTLIST module name CDATA #REQUIRED>\n<!ELEMENT property EMPTY>\n<!ATTLIST property name CDATA #REQUIRED value CDATA #IMPLIED>\n')
(b/'system-ok.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/ok.dtd">\n<module name="Checker"/>\n')
(b/'system-bad.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">\n<module name="Checker"/>\n')
(b/'entity.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module PUBLIC "-//Checkstyle//DTD Checkstyle Configuration 1.3//EN" "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt" [\n<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">\n]>\n<module name="Checker"><property name="charset" value="&xxe;"/></module>\n')
java=['/runtime/jdk/bin/java','-XX:+UseSerialGC','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-Xmx256m','-cp','/runtime/classes:/runtime/lib/*','com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main']
for cfg in ('system-ok.xml','system-bad.xml','entity.xml'):
 r=subprocess.run(java+['-c',str(b/cfg),str(b/'Foo.java')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 blob=((r.stdout or '')+'\n'+(r.stderr or '')).strip()
 one=' '.join(blob.split())[:500]
 print('CFG',cfg,'rc',r.returncode,'marker',marker in blob)
 print(one)
 print('---')
